title: p256-ecdlp: streamed signed BSGS with batched Jacobian normalization

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P for the fixed SEC 2 Section 2.4.2 P-256 generator P (curve y^2=x^3-3x+b), recover x. The deterministic streamed baby-step/giant-step algorithm in proof.md keys both progressions by affine x-coordinate (negation map), uses m=h=2^127 records and stride d=2m-1, covers exactly h*d scalars and therefore succeeds with probability strictly above 1/2 (hence at least 0.39), using less than 2^(547/4)=2^136.75 total target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing, routed memory access, lazy merge-tree sorting, failure paths and verification. No reference operation is used (H=0): every P-256 field operation (4-limb CIOS Montgomery multiplication charged at M=1024 against a derived tally of 281, Fermat inversion charged at I=2^20), every complete mixed Jacobian generation step, every zero-safe Montgomery batch normalization of block size 4096, all memory routing and control are charged through explicit analytic scalar AArch64 instruction bounds, and the exact integer total T=2^40+2^127*856576 satisfies T^4 < 1000^4 * 2^547. Preprocessing is less than 2^136.75 equivalents and is included in total work; peak memory is less than 2^143 bytes; nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. There is no heuristic, randomness, retry or quantum step. This is an analytic conservative accounting control, not a claim of novelty or practical execution.

experiments.purpose: Exhaustively check the signed-window negation-map BSGS coverage and sign logic on small additive groups; check complete mixed Jacobian addition and a=-3 doubling versus affine addition; check zero-safe Montgomery batch normalization including infinity; run the full streamed algorithm with an explicit lazy binary merge tree on small prime-order a=-3 and generic curves; execute the counted 4x64-bit CIOS Montgomery multiplication and the Fermat inversion chain on the real P-256 prime; check the exact integer success and ledger inequalities including T^4 < 1000^4 * 2^547. Finite scope only; does not establish production cost or security.
